name: Added Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a measured extra weight of gravity into the chest.

name: Weighted Cloak
description: Wrap the body in a heavy cloak of qi that slows every blow before it touches the skin.

name: Ironshod Step
description: Take a step so weighted that the ground rings underfoot and the user cannot be shoved back.

name: Tread Sense
description: Feel the pressure of every body nearby on the ground and judge its weight and its intent.

name: Heaped Weight
description: Heap weight on a foe's chest a little more each breath until it cannot rise from a crouch.

name: Mass Elbow
description: Bring a weighted elbow across into a foe's guard with the force of a falling log.

name: Anchor Curse
description: Tie an anchoring weight to a foe's ankles so its legs drag as though in deep mud.

name: Gravity Hammer
description: Bring down a hammering fist loaded with heavy gravity that cracks a guard and the stone behind it.

name: Dense Body
description: Make the whole body so dense that heavy strikes bounce from it and cost the attacker its balance.

name: Leaden Fist
description: Strike inside the field where the fist is heavy and the foe's guard is slow to rise.

name: Dense Veil
description: Draw the field close as a dense veil that smothers the force of blows landing on it.

name: Buoyant Step
description: Ease the user's weight inside the field and drift in light bounds while foes wade through heavy air.

name: Load Gauge
description: Sense the limit of the field and the weight and place of all who stand inside it.

name: Slow Fall
description: Soften the pull on the user and an ally so a great fall costs nothing.

name: Dragging Load
description: Thicken the field so every foe within moves and strikes at half its usual speed.

name: Sink Pulse
description: Send a pulse of added weight through the field that pushes every foe down toward the ground.

name: Mass Spear
description: Compress the field into a narrow spear of weight that drives through a guard in a line.

name: Crushing Weight
description: Raise the field's weight until the ground cracks and all within it are pressed to the floor.

name: Pinned Sky
description: Press down on the air itself so that no foe within the field can leap or fly.

name: Stone Drop
description: Call down a loose stone from above and hurl its weight onto a single foe.

name: Overhead Guard
description: Raise a hard guard above the head that turns aside whatever falls from overhead.

name: Rolling Pace
description: Roll forward from the shoulder to come up inside a foe's guard with the weight of the roll.

name: Plumb Weight
description: Find the point straight beneath a heavy object where it will land if released.

name: Down Stroke
description: Drive both hands straight down onto a foe's lifted guard with a pull that adds to the stroke.

name: Hanging Weight
description: Hang a heavy weight in the air over a foe so it dares not step or lift its arms.

name: Cleaving Drop
description: Drop the edge of the hand on a foe's shoulder as a falling block would split it.

name: Falling Shield
description: Drop a slab of gravity before the user that blocks a charge and then settles as a wall.

name: Great Drop
description: Call a vast weight down upon an area so that it hits like a falling mountain.

name: Pillar Drop
description: Drop a pillar of weight on one foe that drives it to the ground and holds it there.

name: Lodestar Palm
description: Strike with a palm held at the centre of the field so the foe falls toward the blow.

name: Orbit Guard
description: Bend each blow in a curve round the user as a body bends a moving thing in its orbit.

name: Circling Pace
description: Move round a foe on a fixed curve it cannot shake free of or break.

name: Centre Sense
description: Know where the mass of a crowd or a structure gathers and how it will shift.

name: Inward Draw
description: Pull a foe inward along a spiral until it stands face to face with the user.

name: Satellite Strike
description: Set small stones circling the user and loose one at a foe on the turn.

name: Wheeling Blows
description: Send the circling stones outward in a wheel that strikes every foe near the user.

name: Orbit Hold
description: Hold a foe in a fixed orbit round the user so that all its blows fall short.

name: Pulled Together
description: Draw allies close about the user's centre so they stand together and guard each other.

name: Lodestar Collapse
description: Pull every foe toward the user's centre and press them there until they cannot move.

name: Heavy Body
description: Make the user a heavy body so great that blows swing toward it and stop dead on the guard.

name: Billow Palm
description: Strike with a palm that sends a slow heavy swell of weight into the target.

name: Swell Bulwark
description: Rise into a guard that takes a blow like a swell and lets its force roll away.

name: Ebb Step
description: Withdraw a pace just as the foe's weight comes forward and let it fall onto empty ground.

name: Heavy Count
description: Count the rise and fall of the foe's weight to know when it will be lightest.

name: Slow Surge
description: Gather weight over three breaths and release it all at once into a single blow.

name: Bearing Swell
description: Raise a swell of weight round the foe that presses it to its knees.

name: Great Tide
description: Roll a great wave of added weight over an area so all standing in it are flattened.

name: Undertow
description: Pull the foe's footing out from under it with a strong drag toward the user.

name: Sink Palm
description: Strike with a palm that makes the target sink a pace into the ground under the weight.

name: Sunken Guard
description: Hold a guard that sinks every blow's force into the domain's floor.

name: Floor Glide
description: Skim the domain's floor with no weight on the feet while foes plod through it heavily.

name: Depth Sense
description: Gauge how deep each body in the domain has sunk and how hard it must struggle.

name: Weighing Down
description: Weigh down a foe's casting hand so the technique it began falls from its grasp.

name: Heavy Water
description: Make the air of the domain thick as heavy water so every motion of a foe drags.

name: Founder
description: Drive a foe's stance down into the floor of the domain until the knees fail.

name: Settling Weight
description: Settle an ally's weight so firmly into the domain's floor that they cannot be moved by force.

name: Domain Press
description: Bear the full weight of the domain on every foe within it until the floor itself gives way.

name: Bottomless Pull
description: Seal a foe in a pit of pull so deep that no leap or technique can lift it out.
